title: Identity-normalized compact origin for a map out of a closed section
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $k,\ell,F,n\geq1,A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Work on the ordinary small etale and pro-etale constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $B,X$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $f:X\to B$ a separated finite-type morphism with a chosen compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and $s:B\hookrightarrow X$ a closed section, $fs=\mathrm{id}_B$, with quasi-compact complementary open. Use $F^e=Rf_!^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $F^p=Rf_!$ of [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and let
$$\beta_M:C_BF^eM\xrightarrow{\sim}F^pC_XM$$
be the inverse-direction compact-support comparison of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Let $\epsilon_s:C_X(s_*^eA_B)\xrightarrow{\sim}s_*^pA_B$ and $\chi_B:C_BA_B^e\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B^p$ be the canonical closed-constant and constant-sheaf comparisons. Superscripts $e,p$ specify the site.

The identity/proper compactification $(\mathrm{id}_B,s)$ identifies $Rs_!$ with $s_*$ on both sites. The composition comparisons for $f\circ s$ [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons, thm-sf-comp-composition], normalized at the identity, give isomorphisms
$$\sigma_e:F^e(s_*^eA_B)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B^e,\qquad\sigma_p:F^p(s_*^pA_B)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B^p.$$
They obey the source normalization identity
$$\sigma_p\circ F^p(\epsilon_s)\circ\beta_{s_*^eA_B}=\chi_B\circ C_B(\sigma_e).$$
Let $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, and retain an isomorphism $\theta:C_XM\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. For any $c^e:s_*^eA_B\to M$ and $c^p:s_*^pA_B\to K$ satisfying $\theta\circ C_X(c^e)=c^p\circ\epsilon_s$, set
$$\tau_e=F^e(c^e)\circ\sigma_e^{-1},\quad\tau_p=F^p(c^p)\circ\sigma_p^{-1},\quad\psi=F^p(\theta)\circ\beta_M.$$
Then $F^eM$ is bounded below, $\psi:C_BF^eM\xrightarrow{\sim}F^pK$, and
$$\psi\circ C_B(\tau_e)=\tau_p\circ\chi_B.$$
Thus $(A_B^e,\chi_B)$ and $(F^eM,\psi)$, together with the actual representative $\tau_e$, are bounded-below etale-origin witnesses for the source, target and map $\tau_p$, retaining the specified identity-normalized source identification. No invertibility of $c^e,c^p,\tau_e$ or $\tau_p$ is assumed or concluded.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N7-cbeb29e00 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all ten steps in full, and the full statement of every cited node. No new nodes; the statement is identical to live, and the item is still unsplit in live and side-live, so no other group has superseded it. This re-delivery removes the two citations that closed the cycle (cor-cbc-proper-coincidence and lem-trf-proper-composition-site-transport). On both the snapshot and the live clone, the item does not appear in its own dependency closure. Step checks: (1) the bound on F^e M follows from exact j_! and a bounded-below K-injective representative. (2) s is proper and B, X, X̄ are Noetherian. Étale s_* is exact by closed-subtopos localization; pro-étale s_* is exact because the complement is quasi-compact. The identity-open e and q come from lem-coef-proper-identity-open-site-comparison (k=F̄_q, s proper). (3) From S(e)∘C∘q⁻¹=b⁻¹ I derived q∘β_s=b_s∘S(e), and ε_s=P_s(χ)∘b_s holds by the mate characterization d∘ν⁻¹ρ=ρ'∘q. (5) t=js is proper by the triangle lemma, and the square (id_B,s,t,j) is Cartesian because t factors through the open j. (6) The trf pro-étale tower normalization with Ū=B, a=id, p=t gives H=B, b=id, and α reduces to Σ=v∘D_{r,t}∘P_r(Γ); the étale formula of lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons reduces the same way. (7) The site clause of lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate at (id_B,s,t,j) with e_id=1, and β=P_r(e_j)∘b_r from the site-comparison construction. (8) I redid the calculation by hand, using naturality of b_r, the composite and identity laws of prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image, and naturality of Σ_p at χ_B. (9-10) Naturality in the witness, then cancellation of σ_e and σ_p only, never the class maps. Edge cases: empty B forces X=∅; zero maps, M=K=0 and the identity section all work. The source (main-20261015 rank-one Thom Step 1) is respected; no SGA. Batch 5: with the flagged citations added to the item's other citations, the only new trf/pd nodes are six. They are lem-trf-oriented-closed-base-localization, four generic topos lemmas it depends on, and lem-trf-proetale-composition-tower-normalization (a generic normalization of the compact-support compositor). lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate adds nothing beyond what the other citations already reach; its flagged path ends in the generic pod-lisse-module node. None of the three is part of the trace formula, Poincaré duality or their proofs, so all are accepted. Advisory: Step 7 identifies the site-transported Γ^pro with the native pro-étale γ, the identification accepted in Q71.
